definition_short: If the same position appears five times, the game is drawn automatically — no claim needed.
definition_long: FIDE Art. 9.6.1: the game is drawn if 'the same position has appeared, as in 9.2.2 at least five times.' Unlike threefold repetition this needs no claim and no agreement; it happens by force of the Laws. Introduced so that a game cannot continue indefinitely when neither player claims.
epistemic_note: Official rule; the automatic counterpart to the claimable Art. 9.2.

preconditions: The same position, by the Art. 9.2.3 test, has occurred five times

explanation_templates.beginner: The same position has appeared five times, so the game is automatically a draw.
explanation_templates.intermediate: Fivefold repetition ends the game at once, with no claim required.
